LESSON: FLUENCY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Fluency, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three General.

Key inquiry question: What makes it easy to sign read well?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: as the learner varies tone or facial expressions and body language to express feelings conveyed in the text.

● Self-efficacy: as the learner improve their speed in sign reading.

Values:
Respect is inculcated as the learner appreciates the effort of peers and gives positive feedback as they engage in timed sign

reading.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life-skills : Effective communication as the learner improves fluency in sign reading

Link to other Learning Areas:

● Fluency is applied when sign reading texts in all learning areas..

Suggested Learning Resources

Chart, Class readers, Adapted Course books, Flash cards, Recording devices e.g tablets, mobile phone, Dictionary, Internet, Audio-visual recordings,

Posters, Pictures and Photographs, Extracts from newspapers, magazines.
